basics.description: Deploy the Mike AI stack — VNet, Postgres Flexible Server, PostgREST, backend Container App, Key Vault, Storage and observability — into your own Azure subscription. You will need an Anthropic and/or OpenAI API key to enable AI features.

basics.name: envSuffix
basics.label: Environment suffix
basics.toolTip: Short suffix used in all resource names (e.g. dev, prod, demo). Lowercase letters and digits only.

elements.name: pgAdminUser
elements.label: PostgreSQL admin username
elements.toolTip: Admin username for the Postgres Flexible Server.

constraints.validationMessage: Lowercase, starts with a letter, 3–63 chars.

elements.name: pgAdminPassword
elements.toolTip: Min 12 chars, mix of upper/lower/digit/symbol. Stored only in your subscription's Postgres server — never in deployment logs.

constraints.validationMessage: 12+ chars with upper, lower, and a digit.

elements.name: pgSkuTier
elements.label: Compute tier
elements.toolTip: Postgres Flexible Server SKU. Burstable is cheapest; General Purpose is required for HA.

elements.name: pgStorageGb
elements.label: Storage (GB)
elements.toolTip: Initial storage. Can be grown later but not shrunk.

elements.name: enableHa
elements.label: Enable zone-redundant HA (requires General Purpose)
elements.toolTip: Adds a standby replica in a separate availability zone. Requires the General Purpose tier and roughly doubles the Postgres cost.

options.text: Provide at least one AI provider key. Keys are written to the Key Vault provisioned in your subscription and are never visible to the publisher. You can leave both blank and add them via Key Vault later — AI features will be disabled until set.

elements.name: anthropicApiKey
elements.toolTip: From console.anthropic.com. Leave blank to skip.

constraints.validationMessage: Must be empty or start with 'sk-ant-'.

elements.name: openaiApiKey
elements.toolTip: OpenAI key, or an Azure AI Foundry / Azure OpenAI key when using a custom base URL. Leave blank to skip.

elements.name: openaiBaseUrl
elements.label: OpenAI base URL (optional)
elements.toolTip: Leave blank for api.openai.com. Set to your Azure AI Foundry endpoint URL to route requests there instead.

constraints.validationMessage: Must be empty or an https:// URL.

elements.name: enableNatGateway
elements.label: Provision NAT Gateway (recommended for production)
elements.toolTip: Gives outbound traffic a stable public IP. Adds ~30 USD/month — disable for low-cost dev environments.

elements.name: frontendUrl
elements.label: Frontend URL (CORS allow-origin)
elements.toolTip: URL where you will host the Mike frontend. Used as the CORS allowed origin on the backend.

elements.name: lawDailyQuotaGb
elements.label: Log Analytics daily ingestion cap (GB)
elements.toolTip: Daily ingestion cap for Log Analytics. Lower values reduce monitoring cost but may drop logs on busy days.
